# OpenLMS — Moodle LMS for Hong Kong

> An independent Moodle-based open-source LMS service offering for Hong Kong organizations. This marketing website uses Astro. Implementation capabilities require project-level configuration and validation.

## Published prices (HKD)
- Self-managed software license: HK$0; no software seat limit or expiration.
- Managed service below 500 named users: HK$30/user/year.
- Managed service at 500 or more named users: HK$20/user/year, applied to all users.
- Cloud infrastructure: separately billed at cost with no markup.
- On-premises software license: HK$0. Standard installation: HK$30,000.
- Custom development: HK$1,500/person-day against an agreed scope.
- Module fees and standard-format data export/exit fees: HK$0.
- Managed support included; priority response with Scale. Self-managed operation remains the customer’s responsibility.

## Capabilities and boundaries
Six included solution areas: internal training, external training, online learning, microlearning, exam management, and reporting. These are not six native Moodle modules. Moodle core supports courses, quizzes, SCORM 1.2 and H5P. SCORM 2004 is not native. xAPI/LRS, PDF certificates, advanced approvals, and HRIS/SSO connections require suitable configuration, extensions, or development. Moodle and extensions retain their applicable license and copyright notices.
